title: NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
caption:
NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope is capturing the aftermath of massive planetary collisions. By studying 21 extreme debris disks, astronomers are piecing together how rocky worlds like Earth and our Moon are formed.

Source: Sciencedaily - NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
